title: POST /sites – request
description: Create a site. Supervisor token only (not through the site phone). The creator is assigned to the new site. Absent timezone: Europe/Budapest; absent no_data_alert_after_min: 120. Response: 201 (200 for a repeated id), api/site.response.json.

id.description: Optional client-generated id (UUIDv7) of the new record; the server generates one if absent. A create repeated with this id (the app's outbox, e.g. after its Idempotency-Key expired) creates nothing: if the record exists and the caller sees it, the response is 200 with the record as it is now. A deleted record, or another one with this id, is 409 conflict.

no_data_alert_after_min.description: Minutes after the deadline of the last expected round without any data from the device before supervisors are alerted.
